item.title: Fukui Castle Ruins Park: The City's Central Historic Landmark — Guide
item.description: Fukui Castle was once home to a five-storey keep, destroyed by fire in the 17th century and never rebuilt, but the surviving stone walls and moat remain at the historic centre of Fukui City, now surrounded by prefectural government buildings and a pleasant public park open to visitors. Though the keep itself is gone, the site’s stonework and moat offer a glimpse of the castle’s former scale, and the surrounding park’s central location makes it an easy, low-commitment stop for visitors exploring Fukui City on foot.
